name: push-native
title: usePushRegistration (Expo)
description: Registers the device's Expo push token for the signed-in user with the push block.
docs: Needs the push block (`npx better-supabase add push`) and the `src/lib/supabase/client.native.ts` that `npx better-supabase init` writes for Expo. Push tokens need the EAS project id outside Expo Go. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/push.
